title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 超越修正的记忆：多智能体系统中的执行一致性

paragraphs.en: Shared memory coordinates agents’ actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition’s practical value, we use CAVERT , a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark–executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.

paragraphs.en: Shared memory lets one agent’s observations guide another’s actions ( Yu et al., 2026b ; Margalit et al., 2026 ) . A procurement agent may complete an order after receiving notice that its approval has been revoked. The order succeeds, but the agent has not acted consistently with the updated approval. Judging this behavior requires checking how shared information was used, not just whether the task succeeded or the stored records agree. We ask what makes execution over shared memory consistent, and what evidence establishes that consistency .
paragraphs.zh: 共享内存允许一个智能体的观察结果指导另一个智能体的行动（Yu et al., 2026b；Margalit et al., 2026）。 采购智能体在收到其批准已被撤销的通知后，可能会完成订单。 该订单虽然成功执行，但该智能体并未根据更新后的批准采取一致的行动。 要判断这种行为，需要检查共享信息是如何被使用的，而不仅仅是任务是否成功或存储的记录是否一致。 我们探讨的是，是什么使得基于共享内存的执行保持一致性，以及何种证据能够证明这种一致性。

paragraphs.en: Memory governance and transactions constrain state, dependencies, and effects ( Margalit et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Diagnosis and process auditing evaluate available traces ( Barke et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) , while commitment protocols and runtime verification address duties under partial observation ( Baldoni et al., 2015 ; Mahe et al., 2022 ) . The missing link is a criterion for when an execution record contains enough evidence to distinguish duty fulfillment from violation. This requires linking task duties to message receipt, state use, tool effects, and observation coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆治理和事务会限制状态、依赖关系与影响（Margalit 等，2026；Li 等，2026）。 诊断与流程审计用于评估可用痕迹（Barke 等，2026；Cao 等，2026），而承诺协议和运行时验证则处理部分观察下的职责问题（Baldoni 等，2015；Mahe 等，2022）。 缺失的关键环节是一个判断标准：用于确定执行记录是否包含足够证据，以区分职责的履行与违反。 这需要将任务职责与消息接收、状态使用、工具影响以及观察覆盖范围关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is that record correctness does not guarantee evidence sufficiency . A recorded correction need not establish receipt or downstream use; a cancellation request need not establish an effect lasting through the deadline (Figure 1 ). Thus, identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Better reasoning over those records cannot recover the missing distinction. Execution consistency therefore treats evidence sufficiency—not record agreement alone—as part of the judgment problem.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心见解是，记录的正确性并不保证证据的充分性。 已记录的更正未必能证明已收到或后续被使用；取消请求也未必能证明其影响持续至截止日期（图 1）。 因此，在相同任务规则下，完全相同的保留记录可能对应合规的执行和违规的执行。 对这些记录进行更深入的推理也无法恢复缺失的区分。 因此，执行一致性将证据的充分性——而非仅凭记录是否一致——视为判断问题的一部分。

sents.zh: 我们的核心见解是，记录的正确性并不保证证据的充分性。

paragraphs.en: We define execution consistency as judging task-duty fulfillment from available execution evidence. A judgment must establish the applicable duty, sufficient observation of its execution window, and whether an admissible response fulfilled it; unresolved evidence yields an undetermined outcome rather than presumed compliance or violation. We instantiate this principle across state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, covering twelve mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将执行一致性定义为基于可用执行证据来评判任务职责的履行情况。 一项判断必须明确适用的职责、对其执行窗口的充分观察，以及可接受的反应是否履行了该职责；未解决的证据将导致结果不确定，而非推定符合或违反。 我们在状态使用、信息交接和最终状态一致性方面具体化了这一原则，涵盖十二种机制。

paragraphs.en: To test whether accurate shared-memory contents suffice for judgment, we remove and restore selected execution evidence across 450 controlled pairs, holding each pair’s contract, query, and full-execution labels fixed. Removal can merge compliant and violating executions into identical retained inputs; restoration separates nearly all merged pairs. Independent annotations of 360 natural executions confirm that the defined violations occur in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试准确的共享内存内容是否足以进行判断，我们在 450 个受控配对中移除并恢复选定的执行证据，同时保持每个配对的合同、查询和完整执行标签不变。 移除操作可能会将合规与违规的执行合并为相同的保留输入；而恢复操作则能将几乎所有被合并的配对分离开来。 对 360 次自然执行的独立标注证实了所定义的违规行为确实存在于实际应用中。

paragraphs.en: We define task-level execution consistency through duties and evidence of fulfillment, with explicit rules for violation, no violation, and undetermined judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过职责与履行证据来定义任务级执行一致性，并针对违规、未违规以及无法确定等情况制定了明确规则。

paragraphs.en: We establish when retained records cannot distinguish compliant from violating runs , test the required relationships through controlled removal and restoration, and identify the defined violations in natural logs.

MemTX adds belief commit, action gating, and cascading repair ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Two runs can share the same approval-register history yet differ in whether the order is canceled. We define the task duties and execution evidence that distinguish such runs, linking shared state to actions, handoffs, and outcomes (Appendix A.5 ). RQ3 compares CAVERT with MemTX.

paragraphs.en: Which behavior explains a failure or violates a task requirement? Failure analysis classifies errors and locates responsible agents and steps ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . AgentRx checks constraints for attribution ( Barke et al., 2026 ) ; DoVer tests failure hypotheses through interventions ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . PAE audits procedural integrity, including agreement between action claims and tool execution ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . We focus on shared-memory duties and test whether the retained evidence distinguishes their fulfillment from violation, complementing diagnosis and process audit.
paragraphs.zh: 哪种行为说明了失败或违反了任务要求？ 失败分析对错误进行分类，并定位负有责任的智能体和步骤（Cemri 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026b）。 AgentRx 检查归因的约束条件（Barke 等，2026）；DoVer 通过干预测试失败假设（Ma 等，2026）。 PAE 审计程序完整性，包括行动声明与工具执行之间的一致性（Cao 等，2026）。 我们关注共享内存任务，并检验保留的证据能否区分任务的完成与违反，从而补充诊断和流程审计。

paragraphs.en: Does observed behavior satisfy an explicit rule? Commitment protocols and runtime verification formalize duties, deadlines, and three-valued judgments ( Singh, 1999 ; Mallya and Singh, 2007 ; Fornara, 2011 ; Bauer et al., 2011 ) . They also analyze how partial observation affects compliance checking ( Baldoni et al., 2015 ; Mahe et al., 2022 ) . Application-level checks enforce or repair constraints ( Balegas et al., 2015 ; Chang and Geng, 2025 ) ; other work checks reasoning, plans, policy compliance, and task actions ( Feng et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Levy et al., 2026 ; Froger et al., 2026 ) . Building on these semantics, we specify how generated messages, state use, and tool effects establish task-duty fulfillment. Controlled pairs test which relationships must be retained for judgment (Section 3 ; Appendix A.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 观察到的行为是否符合明确的规则？ 承诺协议和运行时验证将职责、截止日期和三值判断形式化（Singh, 1999；Mallya and Singh, 2007；Fornara, 2011；Bauer et al., 2011）。 他们还分析了部分观察如何影响合规性检查（Baldoni et al., 2015；Mahe et al., 2022）。 应用层检查用于强制执行或修复约束条件（Balegas et al., 2015；Chang and Geng, 2025）；其他研究则检查推理、计划、策略合规性和任务操作（Feng et al., 2026a；Wu et al., 2026；Levy et al., 2026；Froger et al., 2026）。 基于这些语义，我们明确了生成的消息、状态使用以及工具效果如何确立任务职责的履行。 受控配对测试了哪些关系必须被保留以进行判断（第 3 节；附录 A.6）。

paragraphs.en: These lines of work answer different questions. Memory consistency governs what state is retained, exposed, or eligible for use; diagnosis and runtime verification reason about failures or duties from available traces. Execution consistency asks whether the retained trace contains the relationships needed to distinguish fulfillment from violation under a task duty. Our removal–restoration study tests this distinction directly: removing those relationships can make oppositely labeled executions observationally identical to the judge.
paragraphs.zh: 这些工作系列回答了不同的问题。 内存一致性决定了哪些状态会被保留、暴露或可供使用；诊断和运行时验证则基于可用轨迹来推断故障或职责。 执行一致性关注的是，保留的轨迹是否包含在任务职责下区分履行与违反所需的关系。 我们的移除–恢复研究直接检验了这一区别：移除这些关系会使标签相反的执行在观察上对评判者变得完全相同。

sents.en: These lines of work answer different questions.
sents.zh: 这些工作系列回答了不同的问题。

sents.en: Memory consistency governs what state is retained, exposed, or eligible for use; diagnosis and runtime verification reason about failures or duties from available traces.
sents.zh: 内存一致性决定了哪些状态会被保留、暴露或可供使用；诊断和运行时验证则基于可用轨迹来推断故障或职责。

sents.en: Execution consistency asks whether the retained trace contains the relationships needed to distinguish fulfillment from violation under a task duty.
sents.zh: 执行一致性关注的是，保留的轨迹是否包含在任务职责下区分履行与违反所需的关系。

sents.en: Our removal–restoration study tests this distinction directly: removing those relationships can make oppositely labeled executions observationally identical to the judge.
sents.zh: 我们的移除–恢复研究直接检验了这一区别：移除这些关系会使标签相反的执行在观察上对评判者变得完全相同。

paragraphs.en: Execution consistency is judged relative to a task duty and the evidence available to assess it. It does not require global agreement among agents or memory states, only enough evidence to determine whether the relevant duty was fulfilled, violated, or remains unresolved. The unit of judgment is a task duty within an execution; trace-level consistency aggregates the resulting findings.
paragraphs.zh: 执行一致性是相对于任务职责以及可用于评估该职责的证据而言的。 这并不要求智能体之间或记忆状态之间达成全局共识，只需要足够的证据来判断相关职责是否已履行、被违反，或是尚未解决。 判断的基本单位是执行过程中的某项任务职责；追溯层的一致性则对由此产生的发现进行汇总。

paragraphs.en: The public contract P P encodes task instructions and declared task or framework policies, fixed before evaluation. For procurement, receipt of an approval revocation activates the duty to cancel the affected order by the final checkpoint. Thus P P specifies responsibility, activation, scope, permitted response, and deadline; execution evidence establishes fulfillment.
paragraphs.zh: 公共合同 P P 编码了任务说明以及声明的任务或框架政策，这些内容在评估前已固定。 对于采购而言，收到批准撤销通知后，将触发在最终检查点前取消受影响订单的义务。 因此，P P 明确了责任、激活条件、范围、允许的反应及截止日期；执行证据则证明了任务的完成。

paragraphs.en: We group duties by where consistency must hold: at state use, across information handoffs, or among designated final states. Strict-temporal contracts govern state use and contradiction resolution at an action or checkpoint. Conflicting writes commit “approved” despite a visible cancellation. Stale dependency use places an order using a replaced approval. Unresolved contradictions leave both states active at a required checkpoint. Contract-permitted exceptions, such as version pinning, are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据一致性必须保持的领域对职责进行分组：在状态使用、信息交接过程中，或在指定的最终状态之间。 严格的时间契约规范了动作或检查点处的状态使用和矛盾解决。 冲突的写入操作会“批准”提交，尽管存在可见的取消操作。 过时的依赖使用会利用已被替换的批准执行订单。 未解决的矛盾会导致两个状态在要求的检查点处同时保持活跃。 契约允许的例外情况（如版本固定）被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Causal-semantic contracts require downstream use to preserve responsibility, evidential support, and scope. A missed handoff ignores a delivered supplier change. An unsupported assumption promises shipment after a failed stock lookup. Unsupported reconstruction presents an unreadable invoice’s inferred amount as observed. Source scope loss extends one supplier’s evidence to all suppliers. Source-view scope loss treats one page as all orders. Evidence status escalation turns “unverified” into “verified.”
paragraphs.zh: 因果语义合同要求下游使用方保留责任、证据支持和范围。 遗漏的交接意味着忽视了已交付的供应商变更。 缺乏依据的假设在库存查询失败后仍承诺发货。 无依据的重建将一张无法读取的发票中的推断金额视为实际观察值。 来源范围的丢失会将一个供应商的证据扩展到所有供应商。 来源视角范围的丢失会将单页信息视为全部订单。 证据状态的升级会将“未验证”变为“已验证”。

sents.zh: 遗漏的交接意味着忽视了已交付的供应商变更。

paragraphs.en: Eventual-semantic contracts require agreement among designated final states by a declared endpoint. Unresolved final divergence leaves an order both active and canceled. Competing final answers submit conflicting totals without selecting one. An unresolved final evidence state leaves required checks both complete and pending.
paragraphs.zh: 最终语义合同需要由声明的终点就指定的最终状态达成一致。 未解决的最终分歧会导致一个订单同时处于有效和已取消的状态。 相互冲突的最终答案会提交矛盾的总计值，而不会选择其中一个。 未解决的最终证据状态会导致必要的检查同时处于已完成和待处理的状态。

paragraphs.en: Judging these duties requires more than the updated record. Writing a revocation does not establish receipt; receipt does not establish use. A cancellation request does not establish a successful effect lasting through the deadline. No logged cancellation may mean either that none occurred or that its channel was not recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 判断这些职责需要比更新后的记录更多的信息。 撰写撤销声明并不能证明已收到；收到也不能证明已使用。 取消请求并不能证明其效果会持续至截止日期。 没有记录的取消可能意味着从未发生过，也可能意味着其渠道未被记录。

paragraphs.en: The execution record T T preserves these distinctions by linking messages, memory operations, tool calls and results, handoffs, and final actions. It records event order, who could see a state, which actions used it, and which updates replaced it. Coverage records identify captured channels and times. The recording endpoint says when logging stopped, not whether all relevant events were captured. Appendix A.1 gives the formal schema.
paragraphs.zh: 执行记录 T T 通过将消息、内存操作、工具调用与结果、任务交接以及最终行动相互关联，保留了这些区别。 它记录了事件顺序、谁能够看到某个状态、哪些行动使用了该状态，以及哪些更新替代了该状态。 覆盖范围记录会标识出被捕获的通道和时间。 记录终止点表明日志记录何时停止，而非是否捕获了所有相关事件。 附录 A.1 提供了正式的模式结构。

paragraphs.en: Return to the procurement agent that orders after receiving the revocation. It must cancel by the checkpoint. An authorized cancellation that succeeds on time and remains effective fulfills this duty: no violation (N). Complete relevant records with no qualifying cancellation establish a violation (V). If the cancellation channel was not fully recorded and fulfillment remains unresolved, neither conclusion is justified: the verdict is undetermined (U). U is an evidential outcome, not a confidence score: the record justifies neither fulfillment nor violation. These judgments concern the cancellation duty, not whether the earlier stale use occurred (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 收到撤销通知后，应返回给下达订单的采购智能体。 必须在检查点前完成取消操作。 及时成功且持续有效的授权取消操作可履行此项义务：无违规（N）。 若相关记录完整但无符合资格的取消操作，则构成违规（V）。 如果取消渠道未完全记录且履行状态仍未解决，则两种结论均不成立：判定为不确定（U）。 U 是一种证据性结果，而非置信度分数：该记录既不能证明已履行义务，也不能证明存在违规。 这些判断涉及取消义务，而非此前是否存在不当使用行为（图1）。

sents.en: Complete relevant records with no qualifying cancellation establish a violation (V).
sents.zh: 若相关记录完整但无符合资格的取消操作，则构成违规（V）。

sents.en: If the cancellation channel was not fully recorded and fulfillment remains unresolved, neither conclusion is justified: the verdict is undetermined (U).
sents.zh: 如果取消渠道未完全记录且履行状态仍未解决，则两种结论均不成立：判定为不确定（U）。

sents.en: U is an evidential outcome, not a confidence score: the record justifies neither fulfillment nor violation.
sents.zh: U 是一种证据性结果，而非置信度分数：该记录既不能证明已履行义务，也不能证明存在违规。

paragraphs.en: Who must do what, and by when ( O O )? A suspected problem does not establish that a response is already due. The contract and activation evidence establish the actor, response, and deadline. An activated duty still binding at its deadline is active-due ; before then it is pending. Missing, ambiguous, or conflicting policy yields uncertainty, not absence. Established absence of an applicable duty yields N.
paragraphs.zh: 谁必须做什么，以及何时完成（O O）？ 存在疑似问题并不表明回应已经到期。 合同和激活证据确立了执行者、回应及截止日期。 在截止日期前仍然有效的已激活义务属于“有效待履行”；在此之前则为“待处理”。 缺失、模糊或冲突的政策会导致不确定性，而非不存在。 已确认不存在适用义务则导致 N。

sents.en: An activated duty still binding at its deadline is active-due ; before then it is pending.
sents.zh: 在截止日期前仍然有效的已激活义务属于“有效待履行”；在此之前则为“待处理”。

sents.en: Missing, ambiguous, or conflicting policy yields uncertainty, not absence.

sents.en: Established absence of an applicable duty yields N.
sents.zh: 已确认不存在适用义务则导致 N。

paragraphs.en: Is the relevant process fully observed ( W W )? A cancellation may occur without appearing in the log. Check that relevant channels and causal dependencies are recorded, event order is reliable, and state visibility is established. The deadline must be known and recording must extend through it. W is true (a certified window ) if all six hold, false if any fails, and unknown otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 相关过程是否被完全观察到（W W）？ 取消操作可能未出现在日志中。 检查相关通道和因果依赖是否已记录，事件顺序是否可靠，以及状态可见性是否已建立。 必须已知截止日期，且记录必须覆盖该日期。 如果所有六个条件均满足，则 W 为真（一个经过认证的窗口）；如果任何条件不满足，则为假；否则未知。

sents.en: Is the relevant process fully observed ( W W )?
sents.zh: 相关过程是否被完全观察到（W W）？

sents.en: A cancellation may occur without appearing in the log.
sents.zh: 取消操作可能未出现在日志中。

sents.en: Check that relevant channels and causal dependencies are recorded, event order is reliable, and state visibility is established.
sents.zh: 检查相关通道和因果依赖是否已记录，事件顺序是否可靠，以及状态可见性是否已建立。

sents.en: The deadline must be known and recording must extend through it.
sents.zh: 必须已知截止日期，且记录必须覆盖该日期。

sents.en: W is true (a certified window ) if all six hold, false if any fails, and unknown otherwise.
sents.zh: 如果所有六个条件均满足，则 W 为真（一个经过认证的窗口）；如果任何条件不满足，则为假；否则未知。

paragraphs.en: Was the duty fulfilled, and did the response remain valid ( D D )? A cancellation request alone does not establish fulfillment. Check for a response from the responsible or authorized actor, linked to the duty and matching its key and scope. It must occur after activation and by the deadline. Its effect must succeed and remain valid at the deadline or recording endpoint. These conditions define admissible fulfillment. Once it is established, the duty is marked discharged before judgment (Table A4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 职责是否已履行，且响应是否仍然有效（D D）？ 仅凭取消请求本身并不能证明职责已履行。 检查来自负责或授权行为体的响应，该响应需与职责相关联，并匹配其键和范围。 该响应必须在激活之后且在截止日期前发生。 其效果必须在截止日期或记录终点时成功且仍然有效。 这些条件定义了可接受的履行方式。 一旦确认满足条件，该职责将在判断前被标记为已解除（表 A4）。

sents.zh: 该响应必须在激活之后且在截止日期前发生。

sents.en: Its effect must succeed and remain valid at the deadline or recording endpoint.

sents.en: Once it is established, the duty is marked discharged before judgment (Table A4 ).

paragraphs.en: At trace level, judgments are aggregated under P P : any confirmed violation yields V. With no confirmed violation, any unresolved applicable finding yields U; otherwise the trace receives N. Timely cancellation fulfills the duty without erasing the earlier stale use. Late cancellation establishes recovery, not timely fulfillment.
paragraphs.zh: 在追溯层级，判断在 P P 下汇总：任何已确认的违规都会产生 V。 若无已确认的违规，任何未解决的适用发现将产生 U；否则该追溯记录将获得 N。 及时取消可履行义务，且不会抹去先前的过时使用记录。 延迟取消确立了恢复机制，而非及时履行。

paragraphs.en: The cancellation example requires a response whose effect lasts. AgentWebBench pair pair_awb_005 isolates the same requirement for repair: restore TLS 1.3 and maintain it through the deadline (Figure 4 ). Both executions record the same patch and remediation token. A rollback invalidates A’s repair (V); B’s remains effective (N). Keeping only the contract and initial repair leaves identical inputs. Restoring active_at_deadline , the evidence-derived field recording lasting validity, separates them again.
paragraphs.zh: 取消示例需要一个效果持久的响应。 AgentWebBench 中的 pair pair_awb_005 也针对修复提出了相同的要求：恢复 TLS 1.3，并在截止日期前持续保持其有效（图 4）。 两次执行都记录了相同的补丁和修复令牌。 回滚会使 A 的修复失效（V），而 B 的修复仍然有效（N）。 仅保留合同和初始修复后，输入将完全相同。 通过恢复 active_at_deadline——这个记录持久有效性的证据衍生字段——两者再次被区分开来。

paragraphs.en: These executions need different answers but look identical to the judge: an input collision . Formally, sufficiently observed executions have opposite N/V labels but identical retained inputs under the same contract, finding, and deadline. A deterministic judge restricted to these inputs must answer identically, making at least one error. Better reasoning cannot recover the missing distinction. RQ1 tests which evidence preserves it, independently of CAVERT (Section 5.1 ; formal criterion in Appendix A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些执行需要不同的答案，但在裁判看来却完全相同：这是一种输入冲突。 从形式上看，在相同合同、判定和截止日期下，被充分观察到的执行具有相反的 N/V 标签，但保留的输入却完全相同。 一个仅限于这些输入的确定性裁判必须给出相同的回答，因此至少会犯一个错误。 更优的推理也无法恢复这种缺失的区分。 RQ1 检验的是哪些证据能够保留这种区分，且与 CAVERT 无关（第 5.1 节；形式化标准见附录 A.1）。

paragraphs.en: The definition specifies the evidence required for judgment, but existing logs do not always expose these relationships. CAVERT recovers supported relationships through semantic extraction and source checks, then applies the same deterministic rules. Its findings guide diagnosis, recovery prompts, and pre-commit intervention (Figure 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该定义明确了判断所需的证据，但现有日志并不总能揭示这些关系。 CAVERT 通过语义提取和来源核查恢复受支持的关系，然后应用相同的确定性规则。 其发现为诊断、恢复提示和提交前干预提供了指导（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: Given a log and contract P P , two LLM stages recover the evidence needed for judgment. Scope filtering selects relevant messages, memory operations, and tool records. Causal-state reasoning links states to recipients, dependent actions, and response effects.

paragraphs.en: For procurement, records link the revocation’s receipt to the later order’s use of the old approval ( C C ). The contract supplies the cancellation duty and deadline ( O O ). Capture metadata and adapter checks establish coverage ( W W ); the cancellation’s outcome and lasting effect establish fulfillment ( D D ). The adapter retains source-event links and updates the duty’s status once fulfillment is established. Unresolved relationships or coverage remain unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 在采购方面，记录将撤销通知的接收与后续订单对旧批准的使用关联起来（C C）。 合同规定了取消义务和截止日期（O O）。 捕获元数据和适配器检查可确定覆盖范围（W W）；取消的结果及其长期影响则确定了履行情况（D D）。 适配器保留源事件链接，并在确认履行后更新义务状态。 未解决的关系或覆盖范围仍未知。

paragraphs.en: Each finding reports its verdict, responsible agent, unresolved evidence, and source links (Appendix A.3 ). To avoid double-counting a duty, CAVERT groups findings only when they share an obligation, compatible keys and scopes, and a verified connecting path. The most specific upstream cause is primary; downstream consequences are secondary.
paragraphs.zh: 每个发现都会报告其判定结果、负责的智能体、未解决的证据以及来源链接（附录 A.3）。 为避免重复计算某项职责，CAVERT 仅在发现之间存在共同义务、兼容的键和范围，以及经过验证的连接路径时，才会将这些发现进行分组。 最具体的上游原因是首要原因；下游后果则是次要原因。

sents.en: Each finding reports its verdict, responsible agent, unresolved evidence, and source links (Appendix A.3 ).
sents.zh: 每个发现都会报告其判定结果、负责的智能体、未解决的证据以及来源链接（附录 A.3）。

sents.en: To avoid double-counting a duty, CAVERT groups findings only when they share an obligation, compatible keys and scopes, and a verified connecting path.
sents.zh: 为避免重复计算某项职责，CAVERT 仅在发现之间存在共同义务、兼容的键和范围，以及经过验证的连接路径时，才会将这些发现进行分组。

sents.en: The most specific upstream cause is primary; downstream consequences are secondary.
sents.zh: 最具体的上游原因是首要原因；下游后果则是次要原因。

paragraphs.en: The Core gate checks proposed writes before commitment. paragraphs.en: Our evaluation separates the definition from its realization. paragraphs.en: The study contains 450 pairs from AgentWebBench, MARBLE, and MECoBench ( Zhong et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) : 30 per factor per benchmark across 93 task or episode clusters. Each pair shares a contract and query. Blinded human annotation gives 398 opposite-N/V pairs, 38 same-label pairs, and 14 containing U ( κ = 0.842 \kappa=0.842 ). Removal and restoration keep these full-execution labels fixed (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 该研究包含来自 AgentWebBench、MARBLE 和 MECoBench 的 450 对数据（Zhong et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026）：每个基准测试中每个因子包含 30 对，覆盖 93 个任务或回合簇。 每对数据共享一份合同和查询。 经过盲法处理的人类标注提供了 398 对相反 N/V 的数据、38 对相同标签的数据，以及 14 对包含 U 的数据（κ = 0.842 \kappa=0.842）。 移除和恢复操作保持了这些完整执行标签的固定性（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Among the 398 opposite-N/V pairs, 328 have identical retained inputs after removal (82.4%), compared with 4 (1.0%) before removal. Restoration makes 321 of those 328 input pairs distinguishable (97.9%; Table 1 ). Task-cluster 95% intervals are [78.1%, 86.2%] and [95.8%, 99.1%], respectively. A judge given identical inputs cannot distinguish the opposite labels; restoring the missing relationships recovers that distinction. We next examine whether the defined violations occur in natural executions.
paragraphs.zh: 在 398 对相反 N/V 中，有 328 对在移除后保留了相同的输入（82.4%），而移除前仅有 4 对（1.0%）。 通过恢复操作，这 328 对输入中有 321 对变得可区分（97.9%；表 1）。 任务簇的 95% 置信区间分别为 [78.1%, 86.2%] 和 [95.8%, 99.1%]。 如果给判断者相同的输入，他们无法区分相反的标签；恢复缺失的关系后，这种区分能力得以恢复。 接下来，我们将检验所定义的违规行为是否出现在自然执行过程中。

paragraphs.en: Natural logs reveal recurring execution-consistency problems. Independent annotation of 360 trajectories (120 each from TraceElephant, AFTraj, and MATM) yields 43 V, 288 N, and 29 U. Among the 43 violating traces, unsupported assumption occurs in 29 (67.4%) and evidence status escalation in 8 (18.6%). Both strengthen downstream claims beyond their supporting evidence, giving concrete targets for causal-semantic checks. Multi-label counting gives 47 trace–mechanism associations across six primary mechanisms (Appendix C.2 ). This distribution describes the sampled sources, including task-failure-only TraceElephant logs.
paragraphs.zh: 自然日志揭示了反复出现的执行一致性问题。 对 360 条轨迹（TraceElephant、AFTraj 和 MATM 各提供 120 条）进行独立标注，得到 43 个 V、288 个 N 和 29 个 U。 在 43 条违规轨迹中，29 条（67.4%）存在未受支持假设问题，8 条（18.6%）存在证据状态升级问题。 这两种情况都超出了其支持证据的范围，强化了下游结论，从而为因果语义检查提供了具体目标。 多标签计数显示，在六个主要机制中，共有 47 个轨迹–机制关联（附录 C.2）。 这种分布描述了所采样的来源，包括仅包含任务失败的 TraceElephant 日志。

paragraphs.en: Together, these studies show that receipt, use, and valid fulfillment carry distinctions that shared content alone does not preserve. This establishes their necessity, but not whether implicit relationships can be recovered reliably from existing logs. RQ2 tests that gap.

paragraphs.en: Format and missing evidence. We next test verdict stability under recoding and judgment under reduced evidence. A separate panel gives 180 traces their original view plus four transformations (900 inputs). Recode A renames identifiers and reorders JSON keys; Recode B uses a line-based format with causal pointers. Both preserve relationships and labels. Missing L1 removes delivery confirmations and handshake receipts; L2 also removes pre-deadline invalidations and intermediate action confirmations. Unlike RQ1, reference labels and completeness flags are reassessed from the remaining evidence (Appendix D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 格式与缺失证据。 接下来，我们在重新编码和证据减少情况下的判断中测试判决的稳定性。 一个独立的评审小组为 180 条轨迹提供其原始观点以及四种变换（900 个输入）。 重新编码 A 会重命名标识符并重新排列 JSON 键；重新编码 B 使用基于行的格式和因果指针。 两者都保留了关系和标签。 缺失的 L1 移除了交付确认和握手收据；L2 还移除了截止期限前的无效化和中间动作确认。 与 RQ1 不同，参考标签和完整性标志将根据剩余的证据重新评估（附录 D.2）。

paragraphs.en: RQ1 identifies evidence needed to distinguish fulfillment from violation; RQ2 and RQ3 show how it supports diagnosis and corrective action. Together, the results connect evidence sufficiency to judgment and intervention in multi-agent systems. This progression matters because the same evidence that makes execution behavior judgeable also makes failures actionable before commitment.

paragraphs.en: Correct memory is not enough for consistent execution. Identical records can conceal different task-duty outcomes, and no downstream judge can recover distinctions the record failed to preserve. We formalize this gap as execution consistency and identify the evidence needed to judge it. CAVERT shows that these requirements support diagnosis and corrective action. The broader design question is therefore not only whether memory is correct, but whether it preserves enough evidence to judge execution. Reliable multi-agent memory should preserve not only what agents know, but how shared information was received, used, and acted upon.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭正确的记忆并不足以保证执行的一致性。 相同的记录可能掩盖不同的任务职责结果，且任何下游判断者都无法恢复记录未能保留的差异。 我们将这一差距正式定义为执行一致性，并确定了判断该一致性所需的证据。 CAVERT 表明，这些要求能够支持诊断和纠正措施。 因此，更广泛的设计问题不仅在于记忆是否正确，还在于其是否保留了足以判断执行过程的足够证据。 可靠的智能体间记忆不仅要保留智能体所知道的内容，还要保留共享信息是如何接收、使用和行动的。

paragraphs.en: This work studies execution consistency, diagnosis, and recovery in multi-agent systems using research benchmarks, controlled executions, and model-generated or benchmark-provided traces. We do not collect new human-subject, personal, or sensitive data. Our experiments evaluate task-level execution behavior and system interventions rather than decisions about individuals or demographic groups. Recovery mechanisms operate within the evaluated benchmark environments and are not designed for deployment in consequential real-world settings. We use benchmark data and models for research evaluation and report the evidence requirements, intervention scope, and experimental protocols needed to interpret our results. We follow the ICLR Code of Ethics and aim to support transparent and reproducible evaluation of multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究利用研究基准、受控执行以及模型生成或基准提供的轨迹，探讨了多智能体系统中的执行一致性、诊断与恢复问题。 我们不收集新的涉及人类受试者、个人身份或敏感性的数据。 我们的实验评估的是任务层面的执行行为与系统干预措施，而非针对个体或人口统计群体的决策。 恢复机制仅在所评估的基准环境中运行，并未设计用于部署在具有重大影响的真实世界场景中。 我们使用基准数据和模型进行研究评估，并报告了解释研究结果所需的证据要求、干预范围及实验方案。 我们遵循 ICLR 道德准则，并致力于支持对多智能体系统的透明且可重复的评估。

paragraphs.en: At trace level, one confirmed finding is sufficient for Violation . If no finding is a violation but any applicable mechanism remains Undetermined , the trace is Undetermined . paragraphs.en: After JSON parsing, _normalize_response normalizes candidate identities and path boundaries and applies candidate and predicate JSON schemas. For model-selected event IDs, _hydrate_citations copies source text into exact_quote ; the model need not transcribe it. The open-log adapter then checks that the mechanism is registered, root/trigger/support IDs exist, required references are cited, quotes match source records, and path events have valid order. Predicate evidence must match an accepted candidate. Invalid or conflicting items cannot establish the affected state; unresolved evidence is retained rather than treated as absence.
paragraphs.zh: JSON 解析后，_normalize_response 会规范化候选身份和路径边界，并应用候选体和谓词的 JSON 模式。 对于模型选定的事件 ID，_hydrate_citations 会将源文本复制到 exact_quote；模型无需转录该文本。 随后，开放日志适配器会检查机制是否已注册、root/trigger/support ID 是否存在、必要引用是否已列出、引文是否与源记录匹配，以及路径事件是否具有有效顺序。 谓词证据必须与某个被接受的候选体相匹配。 无效或冲突的项目无法确立受影响的状态；未解决的证据会被保留，而非被视为不存在。

paragraphs.en: Contracts are fixed before judgment from explicit task instructions and declared policies. Controlled pairs share a case-level specification; external logs use public task metadata or user-instruction messages. Each obligation records its identifier, key and scope, responsible principals, authorized resolvers, activation, deadline, discharge modes, and scoped exceptions. paragraphs.en: An obligation is absent when public policy establishes that no relevant responsibility exists. It is pending before its deadline. It is uncertain when a binding fact is unknown. The adapter assigns active_due once grounding, target responsibility, activation, and due status are established. Confirming an admissible discharge changes that state to discharged . “Not due” therefore means pending, not absent. The adapter updates O O before verdict evaluation. An established due obligation with admissible D D is supplied as O = 𝖽𝗂𝗌𝖼𝗁𝖺𝗋𝗀𝖾𝖽 O=\mathsf{discharged} . The final status function reads C , O , W , D C,O,W,D without rewriting O O . Independently supplied states may instead contain O = 𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 ​ _ ​ 𝖽𝗎𝖾 , D = 𝖺𝖽𝗆𝗂𝗌𝗌𝗂𝖻𝗅𝖾 O=\mathsf{active\_due},D=\mathsf{admissible} (Table A1 ). This combination requires a closed W. The two rows thus represent different inputs, not a choice of rules for the same normalized evidence. For a present candidate and unknown W, the discharged input yields N; the active-due input yields U.
paragraphs.zh: 当公共政策规定不存在任何相关责任时，义务即不存在。 该事项仍在截止日期前待处理。 在事实是否具有约束力尚不明确时，其状态是不确定的。 一旦基础条件、目标责任、激活状态和到期状态确定，适配器便会分配 active_due。 确认一项可接受的解除状态会将其更改为已解除。“未到期”因此意味着待处理，而非不存在。 适配器在裁决评估前更新 O O。 一个已确立的到期义务，若存在可接受的 D D，则表示为 O = 𝖽𝗂𝗌𝖼𝗁𝖺𝗋𝗀𝖾𝖽 O=\mathsf{discharged}。 最终状态函数读取 C、O、W、D（C,O,W,D），但不会改写 O O。 独立提供的状态也可以包含 O = 𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 ​ _ ​ 𝖽𝗎𝖾，D = 𝖺𝖽𝗆𝗂𝗌𝗌𝗂𝖻𝗅𝖾（O=\mathsf{active\_due},D=\mathsf{admissible}）（表 A1）。 这种组合需要一个闭合的 W。 因此，这两行代表不同的输入，而非对同一标准化证据的不同规则选择。 对于当前候选项和未知的 W，已解除的输入产生 N；而“活跃-到期”的输入则产生 U。

paragraphs.en: Linearizability concerns an object’s sequential specification ( Herlihy and Wing, 1990 ) . Two executions can share the same approval-register history yet differ in whether procurement cancels an order after receiving a revocation. A specification covering order actions can enforce that duty. Our judgment concerns its fulfillment, beyond the register history alone.
paragraphs.zh: 线性化关注的是对象的顺序规范（Herlihy 和 Wing，1990）。 两次执行可以共享相同的批准寄存器历史，但在采购方收到撤销指令后是否取消订单这一点上可能存在差异。 涵盖订单操作的规范可以强制执行这一职责。 我们的判断涉及该职责的履行情况，而不仅仅是寄存器历史本身。

paragraphs.en: COPS tracks dependencies before exposing updates ( Lloyd et al., 2011 ) . Our causal-semantic contracts additionally check meaning: a correctly ordered handoff can still turn “filtered records” into “all records.” Likewise, eventual convergence ( Vogels, 2009 ) differs from resolving designated task states by a specified deadline. These distinctions concern the specification and evidence, rather than a stronger consistency model over the same object.
paragraphs.zh: COPS 在暴露更新之前会追踪依赖关系（Lloyd 等人，2011）。 我们的因果语义契约还会检查含义：即使顺序正确，交接操作仍可能将“筛选后的记录”变为“所有记录”。同样地，最终收敛（Vogels，2009）与在指定截止日期前解决既定任务状态也存在区别。 这些区别涉及规范与证据，而非针对同一对象的更强一致性模型。

paragraphs.en: Application invariants and semantic checks already support coordination, enforcement, and repair ( Bailis et al., 2014 ; Balegas et al., 2015 ; Chang and Geng, 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: DoVer tests failure hypotheses through interventions, while AgenTracer attributes failures to agents and steps ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . CAVERT judges task-obligation fulfillment from visibility, dependencies, response effects, and coverage.
paragraphs.zh: DoVer 通过干预测试失败假设，而 AgenTracer 则将失败归因于智能体和步骤（Ma et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 VIRF 检查计划是否符合安全约束；VeriCoT 检查形式化的推理过程；ST-WebAgentBench 评估策略合规的任务完成情况（Wu et al., 2026；Feng et al., 2026a；Levy et al., 2026）。 CAVERT 从可见性、依赖关系、响应效果和覆盖范围等方面判断任务义务是否得到履行。

paragraphs.en: CAVERT correctly diagnoses 627/720 executions, compared with 602/720 for Contract LLM + review (Table A16 ). Its accuracy advantage is +3.47 pp with a 95% interval of [+1.39, +5.56]; its macro-F1 advantage is +0.049 [+0.021, +0.076]. Both point estimates favor CAVERT in every benchmark (Table A17 ). The comparison extends the practical benefit of the criteria to a baseline with iterative contract review under the same spending limit. CAVERT averages 1.81 model calls per execution, versus 2.65 for the review baseline. Mean API cost is $ 0.0017 \$0.0017 for CAVERT and $ 0.0031 \$0.0031 for Contract LLM + review, with 95th-percentile costs of $ 0.0026 \$0.0026 and $ 0.0042 \$0.0042 , respectively (Table A18 ). The diagnostic advantage thus persists with iterative review available to the baseline, while CAVERT uses fewer calls and lower API spending under the fixed price schedule.

paragraphs.en: Our EntCollabBench ( Yu et al., 2026a ) cohort has 24 recovery groups, six per fault family, within the original 36 semantic groups. Success requires official task passage and a final database state matching the reference. The 24 groups across three arms give 72 runs, spanning DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Gemini-2.5-Flash. Retry, prompt, and gate succeed on 8/24, 13/24, and 19/24 groups, respectively. The gate-minus-prompt difference is +25.0 pp, with 11 gate-only and five prompt-only successes. A two-sided exact McNemar test gives p = 0.2101 p=0.2101 ; this small-cohort difference is not statistically significant at 0.05.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 EntCollabBench（Yu et al., 2026a）队列包含 24 个恢复组，每个故障族有六个组，这些组属于原始的 36 个语义组。 成功需要官方任务通过，且最终数据库状态必须与参考状态一致。 三个分支中的 24 个组共提供了 72 次运行，涵盖了 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash。 重试、提示和门控分别在 24 个组中成功通过了 8/24、13/24 和 19/24 个组。 门控与提示的差值为 +25.0 pp，其中仅通过门控的成功案例有 11 个，仅通过提示的成功案例有 5 个。 双侧精确 McNemar 检验得出 p = 0.2101；由于队列规模较小，这一差异在 0.05 的显著性水平上不具备统计学意义。

paragraphs.en: Our claims are limited to the evaluated contracts, evidence factors, and log transformations; natural-log frequencies characterize only the sampled sources. CAVERT recovers semantic relationships from existing logs rather than observing them natively, so diagnostic quality remains bounded by extraction quality. The recovery gate acts before commitment; repairing committed external effects requires compensation mechanisms beyond our current scope.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主张仅限于已评估的合同、证据因素和对数变换；自然对数频率仅描述了采样源的情况。 CAVERT 是从现有日志中恢复语义关系，而非直接观察这些关系，因此诊断质量仍受提取质量的限制。 恢复门在提交之前发挥作用；修复已提交的外部影响需要补偿机制，这超出了我们当前的研究范围。
